name: Windsor Mountain International Summer Camp
description_short: A non-competitive, co-ed overnight camp for ages 7-16 on a 365-acre lakefront site in Windsor, New Hampshire, with campers from the US and abroad. Campers pick their own activities, and sessions run 2, 3.5, 6 or 7 weeks.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on a private 365-acre lakefront site with sailing as a specialty area.

warnings: This page is a general overview with no season dates or prices. Sessions and rates are on the separate Dates & Rates page, so no sessions were recorded and season_year was left blank.
The page says the camp has run 'For over 60 years—since 1961'; that's history, not current-season information.
The page says ACA accredited: check it on acacamps.org and add aca_accredited with aca_source_url
